name: Yaehara Daria
source:
Daria is the only female member of the Forbidden Date Club. Her "handsome" beauty and princely charms makes her very popular even amongst girls. Her mother, Yaehara Botan, is a very famous and acclaimed actress, and as a result, Daria took up acting as well. She too, has been noted for her "gifted" acting skills, and is part of the school's theatre club. Daria also does some modelling on the side, and has appeared on the cover of fashion magazines, though her image gears towards masculine rather than feminine.

Aside from acting and modelling, she enjoys horse-riding and fencing, adding to her "princely" image. Though refined, gentle and charming, Daria hates it when people act overly familiar with her. She is also quite sensitive about most topics surrounding her mother. In spite of her popularity, Daria has her fair share of detractors, whom are referred to the "Anti-Daria".
